description: FashionTrendAI helps fashion designers, merchandisers, creative directors, and brands analyze fashion trends inside ChatGPT. Use it to read runway, color, silhouette, fabric, styling, and market signals, then turn those insights into collection direction, moodboard inputs, product briefs, and design concepts. It supports faster seasonal planning, trend research, range building, and early product development with structured fashion intelligence instead of scattered inspiration.
